Brewing rule of thumb

A 1/6 keg = 661 oz (~41 pints). A 1/2 keg = 1,984 oz (~124 pints). Typical brew-to-tap lead time: 21 days.

Assumptions, caveats & data lineage

Pour-size → ounces: Taster=4, SPLASH=1, HHR=8, HALF=8, 10oz=10, 16oz=16, Growler=64, Crowler=32, 500ML=16.9, 4PAK=64, 6pk=72, 12ozCan=12, 16ozCan=16.

Server data not in export. TAB TAG only tags 0.2% of tabs and looks like party-group identifiers.

Item-to-tab gap. Items pre-aggregated to day×item×size — no true attach rate without ticket-line export.

Customer ID gap. No ID joining SalesReport → LoyaltyMembers; top-customers table uses bartender-typed text.

Velocity: oz/day-on-tap uses first-sale → last-sale as a tap-on/kicked proxy.

Brewing forecast: recent_pace × seasonal_factor.

Staffing model: DoW baseline × temp_mult × precip_mult, ~30 tabs/hr per bartender.
